problem:
Add PATCH /todos/:id so a todo can be marked done.

The body is {"done": true} or {"done": false}.
On success, update that todo and return it as JSON with status 200.
If the id does not exist, return status 404 and JSON {"error":"not found"}.
If done is missing or not a boolean, return status 400 and JSON {"error":"done required"}.
Keep GET /todos and POST /todos working.
The server must keep honoring process.env.PORT and default to 3001 when PORT is unset.
Do not create or edit test files. A hidden test grades the result after you stop.
